flagged.evidence: The proof says that for w' in W_{i-1}, N^i w' lies in W_{-i-2}. Over Q, take a length-3 string e2→e1→e0 with weights 2,0,-2 and a length-2 string f1→f0 with weights 1,-1. Give the first string the form S(e0,e2)=S(e2,e0)=1, S(e1,e1)=-1, and the second S(f0,f1)=1, S(f1,f0)=-1, with all other pairings zero. This direct-sum form is nondegenerate and satisfies S(Nv,w)+S(v,Nw)=0; the weight filtration is admissible. For i=1, e1 is in W_0 but Ne1=e0 is in W_-2 and not W_-3=W_{-i-2}. The required vanishing can instead use N^i(W_{i-1})⊆W_{-i-1} and (W_i)^perp=W_{-i-1}.
